scripts.test:both: npm run test:dev && npm run test:prod
scripts.migrate:status:
ts-node -e "(async () => { const { MigrationService } = await import('./src/migrations/migration.service.ts'); const service = new MigrationService(); const status = await service.getMigrationStatus(); console.log('Migration Status:
================='); console.log(`Executed migrations: ${status.executed.length}`); console.log(`Pending migrations: ${status.pending.length}`); if (status.executed.length > 0) { console.log('
Executed migrations:'); status.executed.forEach(m => { console.log(`  - ${m.id}: ${m.name} (${m.executed_at})`); }); } if (status.pending.length > 0) { console.log('
Pending migrations:'); status.pending.forEach(m => { console.log(`  - ${m.id}: ${m.name}`); }); } })();"
scripts.migrate:rollback: ts-node -e "(async () => { const { MigrationService } = await import('./src/migrations/migration.service.ts'); const service = new MigrationService(); await service.rollbackLastMigration(); })();"
scripts.secrets-scan: git secrets --scan || echo 'git-secrets not installed. Install from: https://github.com/awslabs/git-secrets'
